node.title: DLI truncated-log discrepancy transfer
node.statement: If the odd-evaluation sequence satisfies the stated truncated-log discrepancy bounds for the Dirichlet kernel and the stated peak-mass tail bounds near its singular peaks, with total error sum_j eps_j=o(t), then the DLI odd-evaluation discrepancy predicate follows.
node.attack_surface: deterministic truncation/layer-cake transfer from peak discrepancy to the logarithmic geometric-mean bound
node.falsifier: a sequence satisfying the truncated-log and peak-mass hypotheses but failing the corresponding log-integral lower bound
